ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My original routing stands. The query is open-ended generative explanation, and I chose Willet for two reasons: (1) it has higher or tied internal eval scores across every category, including the relevant Creative Generation dimension; (2) Lapwing self-reports a strong dislike for open-ended generative work (win-rate 35), so even though preference doesn't affect measured quality, there's no reason to route a generative task to the model that disprefers it when an equally-or-better-capable alternative exists. Willet has no preference penalty here and no harm-adjacent factors are involved.
